summary: Applied both spec-review blocking repairs by defining the expected-Issue status integration point and separating preparing auto mode semantics from active runId status checks.

items.title: Expected Issue has no CLI integration point
items.rationale: Specified `senti flow get status [runId] --expect-issue <n>` as the command surface that receives the requested Issue and emits ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH before dispatcher actions.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow[0], requirements R1/R4, acceptance_criteria[0], clarifications[2], and task T-1 now name the expected-Issue status check.

items.title: RunId status guidance conflicts with preparing autoApprove status
items.rationale: Clarified that runId-targeted status autoApprove applies to active flow states, while preparing auto mode relies on the set-auto response and prepare inheritance.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow[3], overview.decisions, requirements R2, acceptance_criteria[1-2], clarifications[1], and tasks T-2/T-3 now separate preparing and active-flow semantics.
